text1180572359123043.text:
Sync Badge

Hands-free hospital communication

Inspired by nurses and designed for fast, reliable collaboration and enhanced workflow efficiency

text.text:
Hands-on nursing needs hands-free communication

Where does hands-on nursing happen? Anywhere the work of patient care is unpredictable, change is constant and teamwork is essential. And whether you need to call a code, call for equipment or call for help, you should always feel connected to the people you rely on.

Communication should fit the way you work

The Sync Badge is a hands-free, wearable communication device that helps enhance workflow efficiency in dynamic, hands-on patient care environments.

text_copy.text:
Quick, reliable collaboration

Communicate seamlessly with team members across units and roles.

text_copy_copy.text:
Workflow efficiency

Help save time and steps, and reduce cognitive load.

text_copy_copy_1820209318.text:
Emergency communication

Quickly reach a response or security team with a dedicated panic button.

standaloneimage.alt: Nurse wearing Sync Badge in front of patient in ProCuity bed

text_copy.text:
Emergency communication

Even in a hospital that cultivates a culture of safety, violence can happen. The Sync Badge has a dedicated panic button you can discreetly press in a moment of distress.

standaloneimage_copy_2003430454.alt: Nurse pressing Sync Badge panic button

text.text:
Summon help at the press of a button

Let the Sync Badge call for help when you can’t.

In an emergency, reach help quickly by pressing the dedicated panic button to discreetly open a communication channel that broadcasts to a response or security team – without drawing attention, and even if you can’t speak.

Responders can see your name and location, hear what’s happening and communicate directly with you if the situation allows.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Nurse wearing Sync Badge responding to emergent situation

text.text:
Reach your team when you need them

In a less emergent situation, use voice commands to broadcast to nearby colleagues for assistance.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Sync Badge integrates with security systems

text.text:
Get critical security system alarms and notifications

The Sync Badge is part of an enterprise hospital communication system that can integrate with security systems for situational awareness, mass notification and more.

The platform can route security system alarms and notifications to the right people at the right time and allow broad communication in the event of a threat.

text_copy.text:
Quick, reliable collaboration

Use your voice to communicate seamlessly with team members across units and roles, while keeping your hands and eyes on the patient.

text.text:
Communicate as easily as you speak

Say “Okay Vocera” to wake up the Sync Badge and start communicating.

Reach the people you need by name, role, group or extension. Urgently broadcast to team members for assistance or to assemble a rapid response group. Page a user or group. Call people who are outside the hospital. Make, receive, transfer and forward calls.

Reach people on the communication device they use

The Sync Badge is part of our enterprise workflow platform, which includes not only hands-free, wearable devices, but also software for smartphones and desktops. Our technology can even interoperate with desktop phones, hospital pager systems and call center systems.

experiencefragment.text: Break through the language barrier Our hands-free, AI-based interpretation service helps care teams focus on patients, rather than searching for translation tools. Accessible directly from the badge, it connects without delays or additional steps or devices. From simple questions to daily non-clinical needs, it helps keep conversations clear and empowers care teams to deliver thoughtful, routine care. AC-GSNPS-SYK-3163351_REV-0_en_us

text_copy_copy.text:
Workflow efficiency

When the work of hands-on patient care is unpredictable and demanding and nursing resources are limited, the Sync Badge can help nurses save time and steps, and reduce cognitive load.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: View of Sync Badge over nurse shoulder with patient in background

text.text:
Know your device is always at the ready

Hands too busy to pull out a phone, unlock it and navigate to a communication app? No problem.

Wear the Sync Badge at the neckline to communicate fast with less disruption to patient care workflow.

Tilt the device toward you and you can read the screen and navigate without needing to remove the device from the clip or lanyard.

See and do the most important things first

Quickly navigate and prioritize communications with intuitive buttons and a three-section inbox that helps you to promptly address new notifications and easily access previously reviewed items.

Identify urgent notifications, and the number and priority of unread notifications, with color coding by priority.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Sync Badge screen with intuitive buttons
Sync Badge keeps you focused on critical tasks

text.text:
Stay focused on critical tasks

When you need to focus on critical patient care workflow tasks, set the Sync Badge to Do Not Disturb mode for 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes – or as long as you need.

Normal-priority calls will automatically route to another user. An urgent call notification can break through Do Not Disturb mode, or if a user is playing a text message or on a call.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Stryker’s Vocera Engage middleware integrates with the Sync Badge

text.text:
Let the alarms and notifications you need come to you

Do you have more important things to do than check the EHR over and over for the information you’re waiting for? We have good news.

You can receive alarms, critical lab results and STAT order notifications directly on the Sync Badge.**

Through integration with Stryker’s Vocera Engage middleware, the Sync Badge can receive information from your EHR, nurse call system, patient monitors, medical devices, scheduling systems, connected beds and stretchers, and more.

text.text: Yes – the Sync Badge integrates with nurse call systems, and that’s not all. Through integration with Stryker’s Vocera Engage middleware, the Sync Badge can receive information from nurse call systems, EHRs, patient monitors, medical devices, scheduling systems, connected beds and stretchers, and more.

text_copy.text: Yes – the Sync Badge enables clear, secure hands-free communication, even when worn under restrictive personal protective equipment (PPE).

The Sync Badge is especially suited to fast-moving environments where nurses’ hands and attention are engaged in patient care tasks and there’s a heavy reliance on teamwork. The emergency department, operating room, labor and delivery, and NICU are prime examples, but the Sync Badge can be used in any department.

The Sync Badge was inspired by nurses and is well-suited to any staff member who needs to keep their hands free for workflow tasks and communicate quickly. Our hands-free, wearable communication devices are also used by physicians in hands-on environments, as well as staff in areas such as environmental services, radiology, pharmacy and facilities management.
The Sync Badge is 1.5 x 3.9 x .7 in. (38 x 98 x 17.5 mm) without the clip. It weighs 2.6 oz. (75 g) with the clip and battery.
